achievements.description: Complete New Game Plus (any difficulty).
achievements.hint:
NG+ is called that way because it allows you to do Dog & Sci-Fi ending but you don't keep anything from the previous playthrough.
Here you can get the Axe (which instakills enemies) and the Pistol-3000 after completing Sci-Fi ending once.

achievements.description: Reach the "Justice" ending.
achievements.hint:
Achieve the "Good" ending.
To do so you must considerably have more discoveries than kills by the end of the game. (21+ points)
There are 80 discoveries and you'll have to kill at least 20 unavoidable enemies.

For a full ending scoring guide, check out the shortcuts & tools section.

achievements.description: Reach the "Forever" ending.
achievements.hint:
Achieve the "Normal" ending.
To do so you must have slightly more discoveries than kills by the end of the game. (Points between 0 to 20)
There are 80 discoveries and you'll have to kill at least 20 unavoidable enemies.

For a full ending scoring guide, check out the shortcuts & tools section.

achievements.description: Reach the "Abandoned" ending.
achievements.hint:
Achieve the "Bad" ending.
To do so you must have more kills than discoveries by the end of the game. (Negative points, below zero)
There are 80 discoveries and you'll have to kill at least 20 unavoidable enemies.

For a full ending scoring guide, check out the shortcuts & tools section.

achievements.description: Reached the "Dog" ending.
achievements.hint:
Achieve the "Dog" ending in NG+.
To do so you must get and use the following items***:
Part 1: 
- Obtain the item "Bronze Coin", found in the Video Store at the Shorefront District - South.
- After getting it, go to the Main Street close to the Pharmacy, where you can find "Guide Dogs for the Blind". Interact with it with the coin in your inventory to proceed.
Part 4:
- Obtain the item "Silver Coin", found in Clara Woods, where the strange postcard was.
- You'll find another Guide Dog in Clara Woods > Ground Level where the laundromat is, where the postcard used to be.
Part 6:
- Obtain the item "Gold Coin", found in Clara SWDP - Different, in the puzzle where you have to open doors with a valve, open door 793 and you'll find the coin
- After finishing the puzzle and dropping the container, go to the next area and in the four way split with the red lights, go towards the end of the hallway to find the final dog.
Once every coin is inserted, you'll get the ending after defeating the final boss.

***NOTE: You can prepare a save file that has the requirements for both the UFO and Dog ending almost done then reload whenever you need to get one or the other.
To do this get all strange books and the access card while at the same time get all the dog coins and deposit them except for the last one in the last chapter.
Once the only step missing is the final one for each ending, make a save then choose whatever ending you want and after you're done reload the save you previously prepared to do the other one.

achievements.description: Reached the "Sci-fi" ending.
achievements.hint:
Achieve the "Sci-fi" ending in NG+.
To do so you must get and use the following items***:
During Part 1: Go to Zoe's House bedroom and under the nightstand you'll find a book "History of Space Flight, 1952 - 1992"
During Part 2: After accepting Richard's Gift, go into the upstairs of the hotel and find a door with buttons on it and input the code given by the strange postcards. It should spell out the following password: Bird, Tree, Planet, Bird, three-legged triangle, Satellite, Satellite, Fish, Rocket, Planet, Dog, Pillar
After the door opens, grab the "Strange Access Card" in the dresser, near the Elephant statue.
During Part 4: Get the book "Freeze me / Wake Me, Elias Fisher" located inside the Stenhouse store within the Atlas Square
During Part 6: Open door 621 in the control room and grab the "a map of nowhere else, the future of interstellar travel" book. In the final corridor, instead of going the normal way, interact with the reader on the wall and use the strange access card to confirm the sci-fi ending.

***NOTE: You can prepare a save file that has the requirements for both the UFO and Dog ending almost done then reload whenever you need to get one or the other.
To do this get all strange books and the access card while at the same time get all the dog coins and deposit them except for the last one in the last chapter.
Once the only step missing is the final one for each ending, make a save then choose whatever ending you want and after you're done reload the save you previously prepared to do the other one.

achievements.hint: I recommend doing this in ng+ for the axe and maybe pistol from the sci-fi ending. You can also do this while going for the "Just Making Things Worse" achievement, since it requires you to have more kills than evidence.

achievements.description: Obtain the Pistol-3000.
achievements.hint:
After Finishing the Sci-Fi ending in NG+, start another NG+ and head to storage section past the rail with all the "For Sale" signs and pick up the Pistol-3000.
As Richard, you can find it in the Boardroom close to the Level 3/4 Access Card you need to obtain to progress.

achievements.description: Obtain the Axe.
achievements.hint:
At the start of a NG+, head to storage section past the rail with all the "For Sale" signs and pick up the Axe.
As Zoe, you can find the Axe in the shed in front of Mr. Stewart's house.

achievements.description: Create 20 new items by combining others.
achievements.hint: Gause + Alcohol or IV Fluid + IV Bag and some story/key items will be how you'll get this. If you don't get it in your first run, don't worry, you can do it in the next one.

achievements.description: Kill at least one enemy with Plank, Pipe, Pistol, Shotgun, Flare Gun, Bottle and Brick in a single playthrough.
achievements.hint:
Kill at least one enemy with Plank, Pipe, Pistol, Shotgun, Flare Gun, Bottle and Brick in a single playthrough.
Check "Pinpoint Inaccuracy" and "Long-Range Masonry" for other killing related achievements.

*Be sure to get the Plank kill before Clara Woods, as it will stop spawning after that part.
**You can make your brick kill be the "Long-range Masonry" achievement.
***Since enemies take around 10+ bottles to kill normally, get the bottle kill with one of the Crawlers or laying enemies in the ground.
****If you're really worried about your ending score, do know that when you don't play as Simon, kills don't count for those characters, and that Crawlers also don't count as kills for any of the characters.

achievements.description: Hit any enemy in the head with a brick from over 15 meters away.
achievements.hint: The tricky part is that it has to hit *the head*. A body-shot won't count.

achievements.description: Land a head shot on any enemy with the Flare Gun from over 10 meters away
achievements.hint: You find the Flare Gun in one of the lockers of Part 4's Clara Woods. The flare-gun is incredibly inaccurate so this can be a bit of a frustrating achievement to get. Be sure to keep a save nearby and if possible use a stationary target such as the many fake corpses in Clara Woods.

achievements.description: Silence 30 Widows.
achievements.hint:
Silence (kill) 30 Widows.
There aren't enough Widows in a single playthrough to get this achievement, but during Richard's sections of the game, you'll be able to find these enemies. Feel free to reload a save close to a spot where you know there will be a few of them so you can farm it. In the linked video, the video showcases a single widow, but I was able to get 3 in that spot so it was quite easy.

Richard segments don't count for the "enemy kills" required for endings.

achievements.description: Throw a bottle into the air, and shoot it with the pistol.
achievements.hint: Throw a bottle into the air, and shoot it with the pistol. I found it easier to do when throwing the bottle directly upwards.

achievements.description: Wait in a hiding spot for 60 seconds.
achievements.hint: What counts as a "hiding spot" is anything you can interact with that says "Hide".

achievements.description: Distract 10 Enemies with a radio in the world.
achievements.hint: You can do this with the same enemy and with the same radio you find, if you want.

achievements.description: Distract 20 Enemies with a bottle.
achievements.hint: While undetected by an enemy, throw a bottle to the ground to make them head there. I believe you must remain undetected for it to count as a distraction.

achievements.description: Successfully distract an enemy by setting off a car alarm.
achievements.hint: Throw an object to a car or hit it with a melee weapon to start an alarm.

achievements.description: After meeting Richard, do not use a phone to save the game.
achievements.hint: Don't do manual saves. You have to do one manual save, that won't count, the first time to progress the story and meet richard, but after that don't use manual saves and you should be good. This game has auto-saves so dont worry too much.

achievements.description: Unlock all resource containers.
achievements.hint: There are 7 keys and 7 Containers, one in each Part with Part 6 having two.

achievements.description: During the missions “Rounds” and “The Patient”, don’t use any healing items.
achievements.hint: Complete all Zoe chapters without using healing items.
